sepsis_sample_selection: Uniform without replacement from official S3 file listing; seed 0; independent of labels or model results
sepsis_task: Retrospective 1:1 event-centered case-control DEVELOPMENT task. Case index = first positive official early-label hour; clinical onset=index+6. Require index>=12 and observation through onset. Predictors use only (index-12,index]. Controls never have a positive released label, with index drawn from SOURCE case-index distribution conditional on adequate prior and follow-up observation. No future measurements or label-derived variables are predictors.
readmission_task: 30-day readmission, positive iff readmitted=<30; prediction at discharge
readmission_domain: Other admission sources to emergency room (admission_source_id=7), following TableShift's domain definition
readmission_cohort: Exclude expired discharge codes 11,19,20,21; retain one eligible encounter per patient, minimum encounter_id; omit patient/encounter IDs and domain indicator from predictors
source_preprocessing: Fit imputation, scaling and categorical encoding on source-training rows only
target_information: Unlabelled target covariates for context construction and density-ratio estimation; no target labels for fitting, selecting thresholds, tuning or selecting methods
base: One random source context with natural class proportions; same labelled source pool is available to all methods
shared: Base plus five existing classification context roles: target-neighbor, representative, locally-stable, feature-subspace, low-conflict; source-calibrated reliability and entropy gate
specific: Retains Shared bank and policy fallback; adds target-matched sampling, density-ratio sampling, and partial numeric median/IQR alignment; source calibration can use unlabelled domain-density weights
method_status: Medical-task transfer/reconstruction of context rules, not a claim that archived exact TabACE implementation was recovered
decision_threshold: Select using source calibration only; identical threshold-selection procedure for each method
significance: Patient-paired bootstrap and exact McNemar, Holm across four OOD adjacent comparisons in this development experiment.
selection: Same four gain/regularization candidates per tier as natural-cohort study. Source-only fit/validation. No test-based ranking enforcement.
casecontrol_balance: 1:1 per hospital and per train/cal/ID/OOD split; uniform seeded control sampling. Patient-disjoint within each direction.
previous_evaluation_overlap: These public patients have been used in the earlier different-landmark study; this is explicitly exploratory development, not an untouched confirmatory validation.
negative_index_distribution: Source-training CASE indices only (same stratified split as prepared training), before source-calibration or test labels are used for fitting. Require full prior12h and observed following6h.
